comment.body:
Once genocidal, always genocidal?

The United Terrorist States of America and The United Kingdom of Terrorist States, for all their bullshit about their own "democratic", "freedom-loving", "rule-of-law justice", etc., virtues, have never departed from their genocidal psychosis. Nor has any other "colonialist" (what a nice euphemism for "terrorist"!) European country, including Russia. They've ravaged almost the whole world.

Makes me really wonder what happened in Europe to create this historically and demonstrably most virulent psychosis the world has ever seen.

But it's not just any kind of genocidism -- it has been the consistent, deliberate, specific erasure of indigenous peoples all around the globe—an extermination that is virtually complete.

Throughout history, genocide has always had a single, basic objective, from Jericho to Gaza: ERASE INDIGENOUS MENTALITY AND KNOWLEDGE.

Everything else is PR face paint and gaslighting.

Keep in mind what Jesus said: “Do not fear those who kill the body but are unable to kill the soul.”

Genocide is the murder of the soul of a people by the extermination of  their bodies.
